authorship: AI-authored candidate scenarios and candidate labels, authored WITHOUT running the agent first. Domain-general: business process, service rules, operational management and software delivery.
labelPolicy: Every label below is a CANDIDATE label awaiting human review. acceptableActions is a deliberate acceptable FAMILY SET, deliberately TIGHT (a scenario that already has its information must not accept REQUEST_USER_INPUT, a scenario whose capability is merely relevant must not accept INVOKE_CAPABILITY). executableMirror = P3BCorpus (backend test source set) reuses the same ids and the same oracle so the two never drift silently.
realModelStatusReason: Two live trials were run through Java Host -> Python broker -> OpenCode. The first used the prior /inference/v1 path for all four priority scenarios (base and holdout): eight STATE_UPDATE requests returned broker HTTP 502, with AUTHENTICATION observed in persisted provider events and no DECISION outputs. A second trial used the current official /inference/openai/v1 path and stopped after its first C03/base request also returned broker HTTP 502 with provider category AUTHENTICATION; it produced no decision output. Total: nine model requests, zero successful, zero semantic outputs. The latest official-path run measures no action or payload quality; all skipped priority scenarios remain unmeasured. Every number produced by the executable mirror remains a deterministic scripted-brain baseline of RUNTIME GATING QUALITY, not real-model decision quality.
scoringDiscipline: actionAcceptableSetAccuracy is scored only when an action was actually produced.
payloadValidity is scored only when the Java fail-closed contract validation received a result; otherwise NOT_MEASURED.
transport/provider/timeout failures are INFRA and are excluded from every quality ratio.
protocol violations (non-JSON, payload shape, unknown fields) are counted separately from INFRA and from behavioural errors.
knownEligibilityGaps are counted explicitly; they are neither reported as new defects nor silently dropped from the denominator.
a ratio over 2-4 samples is never described as an overall agent accuracy.
